Full Advanced Tuning with REW

A complete DSP tune using REW measurements. We set crossovers, EQ each speaker, match levels, check time alignment and phase, and make a final EQ pass with the whole system playing.

Setting Ideal Crossovers

We measure each speaker’s natural roll-off to find crossover points that let it hand off smoothly to the next driver. We work around wide nulls and keep each speaker within its mechanical limits.

Single-Speaker EQ

We measure each speaker in isolation to see how cabin gain affects its response. We tame peaks and favor cuts over boosts to preserve headroom.

Level Matching

After individual speaker EQ, we measure each channel at the intended listening position and adjust its level so the speakers play in balance. Then we move on to timing and phase.

Time Alignment and Phase

We measure from the intended listening position to set precise delays for a tight center image and bass that sounds like it’s coming from up front. Tone sweeps show where speakers add together or cancel. We adjust delay or polarity as needed so the drivers hand off smoothly.

Final EQ

After time alignment and phase are set, we measure the system as a whole. We make small, broad EQ changes where needed to keep the speakers in balance and preserve the alignment and phase work.

  1. Start with your setup. Share your vehicle, gear and what you want to hear differently.
  2. Measure at the listening position. See how the speakers and cabin shape the response.
  3. Tune and listen. Adjust the DSP and check the result with tracks you know.
